title: Pilot Study of MammoGRIP for Breast Positioning, Image Quality, and Patient Comfort in Mammography
official: Pilot Study of MammoGRIP for Breast Positioning, Image Quality, and Patient Comfort in Mammography
summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of MammoGRIP® in improving mammographic image quality and minimizing repeated breast positioning compared to standard practice without MammoGRIP®.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women aged 40-75 years undergoing routine screening or diagnostic mammography
* Ability to provide informed consent
* Prior mammogram results are available for the patient in Epic

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of bilateral mastectomy
* Active skin condition or open wounds on the breast or chest
* Known allergy to components of MammoGRIP®
